original_instruction_findings: Pinned module hash, contiguous32/26/26byte slices and code hashes reverified directly from original PE. Fresh Capstone covers all bytes and LLVM output bytes exactly agree. No overlapping PE base relocations.

All five inventory direct-call opcodes independently rechecked against actual original bytes. Both D0 callsites unwind and return immediately after the call without overwriting EAX; their owning function identities remain unknown in the inventory.
D0 compares old with unsigned FFFFFFFF before adding. At old=FFFFFFFF it writes1 and leaves EAX=FFFFFFFF; at old=FFFFFFFE it writes/returnsFFFFFFFF.
D4/D8 add1 modulo2^32, then replace resultingFFFFFFFF with1. Thus old=FFFFFFFE writes/returns1 and old=FFFFFFFF writes/returns0.
Instructions need only ECX input and one ordinary four-byte field. Other entry volatile registers/flags do not influence the declared result; nonvolatile registers and DF remain obligations.
